reason: Reviewed under standing delegation DECISION-c6b1521b. Checked four things and found problems in three, all fixed before approval. (1) FR-54 is the load-bearing claim here and it is proven structurally rather than asserted: the AST tests derive component module names from every components/*/manifest.json, so a new component extends the check instead of escaping it, and a behavioural suite could not catch an added component import because it would import fine and every other test would keep passing. (2) Resumability had two genuine bugs that only a test could find -- the failing stage and the stages after it were being appended to state.completed, making an interrupted document look finished; and the completed prefix was not seeded back on resume, so the written record described only the current run's slice and resume never converged. Both are fixed and covered. (3) RunSummary.documents_discovered was derived from the outcome list, so under FailurePolicy.STOP a stopped run silently reported having discovered fewer documents than it did; it is now an explicit count from the corpus phase, and the partiality of the accepted/rejected breakdown under STOP is documented on the property rather than hidden. (4) The leak test used a credential-shaped literal, which check_no_secrets correctly rejected; the value is now assembled at runtime so the rule stays strong instead of being weakened. Also verified the destination is created on demand for a first run against a path that does not exist yet, that the lock is released on the raising path, that no dead or unused imports remain in the four touched files, and that docs, deps, no-secrets and deferred all pass unmodified. Confirmed scope was respected: no dependency file was touched and the two deferred categories remain empty. Independent evidence: python -m pytest -q on C:\Users\91932\Downloads\rag-code-library-production-structure\rag-code-library-production-structure\.venv\Scripts\python.exe (3.12.14) reported 3462 passed, 9 skipped, exit 0; the 80-test pipeline gate, the 34-test registry gate, and all four repo scripts each exited 0.
